reviewText: Really impressed by RUM RUMMY. The UI transitions are smooth, matchmaking is fast, and table mechanics feel natural.
Game logic thoda slow lag raha hai, kabhi kabhi touch control mein issue hota hai. Need better optimization for older devices.
The interface is very clean and the sorting feature is quite helpful for beginners. Would love to see more table themes in the future updates though.
Super smooth gameplay! Love how fast the app connects to tables. Best way to pass time with friends.
